description: This PHP class represents a data transfer object (DTO) called PendingAction, which encapsulates information related to pending actions within the OrangeHRM Dashboard module. It interacts with an ActionSummary object to generate a summary of pending actions.

classes.name: PendingAction
classes.description: A DTO class that represents a summary of pending actions for display or further processing within the dashboard. It uses traits for localization support and holds an ActionSummary object to generate concise pending action data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the PendingAction object with an ActionSummary instance.

methods.name: generateActionSummary
methods.description: Generates an array summarizing the pending actions if there are any; otherwise returns null.
